# CG-REQ-023: Request type widened

The JSON types accepted in a request grew.

**Why it matters:** Additional types widen accepted requests.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.typeChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {where} accepts more types ({from} → {to}).
>
> Existing consumers are unaffected.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: integer → number

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: integer}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: number}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. POST /x: the request body (application/json) accepts more types (integer → number).

### Fires: type removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, maxLength: 3}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {maxLength: 3}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. POST /x: the request body (application/json) accepts more types (string → any).

### Does not fire: narrowing

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: number}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: integer}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
